listen_address.description: Local IP address to bind the UPnP/PCP/NAT-PMP service (e.g., 192.168.1.1). Use '0.0.0.0' to listen on all interfaces.

ext_ifname.description: External (WAN) network interface name (e.g., 'ppp0', 'eth1', 'br0'). Must be reachable from the internet.

listening_ips.description: List of internal IP addresses for which to enable UPnP port mapping requests.

upnp_enabled.description: Enable UPnP IGD (Internet Gateway Device) functionality. Disable to restrict automatic port forwarding.

natpmp_enabled.description: Enable NAT-PMP support (older protocol used by Apple and some Windows clients).

pcp_enabled.description: Enable PCP (Port Control Protocol), a modern successor to NAT-PMP with improved features.

secure_mode.description: Restrict port mappings to traffic from the same subnet and enforce stricter validation. Recommended for security.

legacy_module.description: Enable legacy behavior for very old UPnP clients (e.g., Windows XP). Disable unless required.

system_uptime_threshold.description: Time (in seconds) after system reboot to perform port mapping garbage collection. Set to 0 to disable.

max_ports_per_device.description: Maximum port mappings allowed per device. 0 = unlimited. Prevents resource exhaustion.

max_total_ports.description: Maximum total port mappings system-wide. 0 = unlimited. Helps prevent exhaustion of port space.

port_range_min.description: Lowest port number allowed in auto-allocated mappings. Must be ≥ 1 and ≤ port_range_max.

port_range_max.description: Highest port number allowed in auto-allocated mappings. Must be ≥ port_range_min.

lease_enabled.description: Enable time-limited (lease-based) port mappings instead of persistent ones.

lease_duration.description: Default lease duration (in seconds) for mappings when lease_enabled=true. 0 = infinite.

igmp_enabled.description: Enable IGMP/MLD snooping support to forward multicast traffic (e.g., for IPTV).

ssdp_notify_enabled.description: Broadcast SSDP notifications when mappings change or at startup. Disable for private/quiet networks.

ssdp_broadcast_interval.description: Interval (in seconds) between SSDP broadcast advertisements. Lower values improve discovery responsiveness but increase network traffic.

upnp_uuid.description: Custom SSDP/UPnP device UUID. If empty, auto-generated from MAC and hostname. Required for stable identification across reboots.

friendly_name.description: Human-readable name displayed for the UPnP device in client tools (e.g., router GUIs).

model_number.description: Model version number advertised via SSDP/UPnP.

presentation_url.description: URL prefix for embedded web UI (if any).

min Lease Time.description: Minimum lease time (in seconds) for port mappings.
